Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Wrote annotation templates using `$values` and `$labels` to include dynamic query data in alert messages
- Previewed annotation templates to verify output and catch syntax errors
- Created a conditional severity label template using `if`/`else` logic
- Verified how templated labels affect notification policy routing
- Saved the rule with active templates

---
